label: SCENARIO VIEW of operational National Water Model output (current modelled river flow compared with each reach's own recurrence flows). NOT a closure forecast, not a probability, and not a statement that any road is open or closed. No surge, tide, drainage flooding, deck height or scour. The model's high-flow skill at small streams is limited (see README).
product: NWM operational Standard Analysis & Assimilation, channel_rt, tm00 (hourly)
level_definitions: RL0 = flow at or below the reach's 2-year recurrence flow; RL2/RL5/RL10/RL25/RL50 = flow strictly above that recurrence flow (highest reached); 'not_assessed' = reach has no usable recurrence flows (hazard_threshold_ok false)
